description.fallback: The Mujina Bandits leave to notify Shojoji. Boruto meets Tentō at the Konoha Mountain Villa, which has been entirely rented by Ikkyū. He has Boruto show him his jutsu, and Boruto attempts to shock him with the Harem Technique.

intro.fallback: The Mujina Bandits leave to notify Shojoji.
Boruto meets Tentō at the Konoha Mountain Villa, which has been entirely rented by Ikkyū.
He has Boruto show him his jutsu, and Boruto attempts to shock him with the Harem Technique.

outro.fallback: Yamaoka finds them, and unsuccessfully tries to dissuade Tentō from training.
He explains to Boruto that his father gave him the credit card because he had no idea what his son actually liked, so Tentō began collecting cards and participating in tournaments.
